title: Software Engineering and Web Frameworks Quiz
description: A 30-question multiple choice quiz based on MVC, Spring, REST APIs, testing, UI design, and external API integration.

questions.text: In the MVC architecture, which component is responsible for managing application data?
What is the main responsibility of the Controller in MVC?
options: Handle user input and manipulate the model

questions.text: Which annotation marks a Java class as a database entity in Spring?
Which Spring layer is responsible for handling business logic?
What does CRUD stand for?
Which Spring feature automatically generates query methods from method names?
According to the Eight Golden Rules of Interface Design, what should happen after a user action is completed?
options: The user should receive closure and feedback
The user should log in again

questions.text: What is a dark pattern in UI design?
options: A deceptive interface technique that manipulates users

questions.text: What is the purpose of specification by example?
Which structure is commonly used in example-based specifications?
Why are edge cases important in testing?
options: Many bugs occur at boundaries and extremes

questions.text: Which annotation is used in Spring to trigger validation on request data?
What is a flaky test?
options: A test that only runs once
A test that sometimes passes and sometimes fails without code changes

questions.text: Which testing level focuses on testing a single component in isolation?
What is the main disadvantage of unit testing?
Which type of test double provides pre-programmed expectations of method calls?
What does REST stand for?
Why are REST systems described as stateless?
options: The server stores all client sessions
The server cannot process POST requests

questions.text: Which HTTP verb is typically used to retrieve data?
What is idempotence in REST?
options: A request changes the database every time
Running the same request repeatedly has the same effect

questions.text: What is a URI in REST?
options: A unique identifier for a resource

questions.text: What is content negotiation in REST?
options: The client specifying the desired representation format

questions.text: What does HATEOAS encourage in REST APIs?
options: Including links to related resources and actions

questions.text: Why might developers choose to use an external API?
options: To implement existing features instead of building them from scratch

questions.text: What is geocoding?
Which practice is recommended when programming using examples from documentation?
What is a risk of relying on external APIs?
options: The API may fail or have usage limits
The API removes the need for testing

questions.text: What is the purpose of an API in software engineering?
options: To allow software systems to communicate

questions.text: In Mastodon integration, which class is used for retrieving social media feeds?
What is the role of the Mastodon service layer in an MVC application?
options: Communicate with Mastodon APIs separately from the controller
